title: ComplianceReport
description: A compliance report summarizing audit activity, policy adherence, or regulatory compliance status for a defined reporting period.

id.description: Unique identifier for the compliance report

descriptor.description: Human-readable title of the compliance report

periodStart.description: Start date of the reporting period

periodEnd.description: End date of the reporting period

generatedOn.description: Timestamp when the report was generated

status.description: Current status of the compliance report

totalEvents.description: Total number of events covered by the report

summary.description: Executive summary of the compliance report findings
